At 50 degC ambient, 1.09 A out and 19 V to 24 V in, Figure 8-19 gives 88 % to 89 % efficiency: 0.44 W to 0.49 W lost, about 0.35 W to 0.43 W in the IC. Above TJ 85 degC VFB is 784 mV to 816 mV (+/-2.0 %) and the same budget is 3.5 %, 3.184 V to 3.416 V, outside 3.201 V to 3.399 V. The load-regulation term is a typical curve with no limit.
